title: Luther's Commentary on Galatians
author: Martin Luther
license: Public domain (Theodore Graebner translation, Concordia Publishing House, 1918)
description: Later-Reformation exposition of Paul's Epistle to the Galatians, represented by Theodore Graebner's abridged English translation of Luther's commentary. The checked-in corpus covers Galatians chapters 1–6 only and makes no claim of whole-Bible coverage.
attribution: Martin Luther, Commentary on St. Paul's Epistle to the Galatians — Theodore Graebner's abridged English translation (1918), public-domain edition
